item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 26/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring showery and hot weather to the coast of Guangdong today. Winds are expected to be weak over Guangdong early next week, showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. Tropical Cyclone Saola will linger over the seas east of Luzon in the next couple of days and intensify gradually. A relatively weak northeast monsoon will reach southern China midweek next week. Under the combined effect of the monsoon and the outer subsiding air of Saola, the weather will be very hot and relatively dry over southern China. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Saola is expected to subsequently move in the general direction of the vicinity of Taiwan and the coast of Fujian and eastern Guangdong, but its movement remains uncertain.
